Day one of the European paper account, 9 November 2026. The trader made no trades. Equity stays at 1000 euros, all in cash. The day result is zero and the total result is zero. No orders were sent, so there were no fills, no costs and no rejections. Custody cost was zero. Reconcile is consistent and there are no warnings. What moved: crude fell about 3.6 percent after Trump ruled out new Iran strikes. Gold, copper and European indices rose on a US-China truce extension. US CPI is still pending.
